dataset.name: WANDS real 55 tenants, incrementally controlled-stress replicated up to a real safety-capped ceiling; quiet tenant: Rugs-copy0

engine_config.native: commerce_core::index::CatalogIndex, 1 quiet tenant + 3 noisy round-robin worker threads, incremental build with RSS checks every 250 tenants, 9GB self-process RSS safety cap

headline_result.h12_status: CONFIRMED in all 3 runs -- ~3,500 query-capable tenants safely reached under a disclosed 9GB envelope, latency SLO holds
self_caught_issues: first-draft eager build-then-check pattern OOM-killed at n=6500 by the real 13.34 GiB cgroup limit; fixed via incremental build with RSS checks during construction
n=55 baseline checkpoint's p99 was an unstable cold-start artifact (1.777/4.104/2.755 ms across runs) while p50 stayed tight (1.290/1.289/1.286 ms); p50 used as primary metric
headline_result.distinction_clarified: H5's 6,500-tenant memory ceiling is index-only (no resident Catalog); H12's query-capable ceiling (both Catalog+CatalogIndex resident) is materially lower at ~3,500 tenants for the same disclosed envelope
